howto: The green car wants to leave by the EXIT on the right of the car park.
Drag any car along its length: cars only slide forwards and backwards, never turn.
Slide the blockers out of the way, then slide the green car out of the exit.
Finish in the fewest moves for 3 stars. One move = one slide of one car, any distance.
tips: Work backwards: find what blocks the green car, then what blocks that.
Trucks (3 long) are the hardest to shift; move them early.
Undo is free and takes back one move.
Hint shows a move from a perfect solution, found by a solver from your current board.

controls.keyboard: Space or Tab picks the next car (white outline), arrows slide it, Z undoes, H hints. On the title, arrows pick a level. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag a car along its length. Undo and Hint sit under the car park. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title screen switch between three packs of 8 puzzles: 4-7, 9-12 and 16-22 moves in a perfect solution.

cheats.effect: Tap one car to tow it off the board
The best next move is always outlined in gold
Every level in every pack unlocked (this session only)

features.hints: Hint button (and Pause > Hint): a solver finds the shortest solution from your current board and outlines the next car with an arrow
features.undo: Undo takes back the last move
features.level-select-or-daily: 8 levels per pack with stars on the title screen; the difficulty buttons switch packs
features.results: PARKED OUT! card with stars, moves and the best possible move count
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-parking-puzzle blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)
